info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Payments Payments Void-v2-spec
info.description: The Void Payment API allows users to cancel previously processed payments, ensuring accurate financial records and customer satisfaction. This endpoint is primarily utilized by payment processors and e-commerce platforms to handle transaction reversals in a seamless manner. By sending a DELETE request to the specified endpoint, consumers can effectively manage payment status and processes. This functionality is essential for businesses aiming to maintain integrity in their payment systems and respond promptly to customer requests.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to void a payment transaction that has been previously authorized. It effectively cancels the payment and ensures that funds are not captured. Please provide the required payment ID for the transaction you want to void.

requestBody.description: Request body to initiate the void operation for a payment. Provide the necessary details in JSON format to specify which payment to void.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for voiding a payment operation using the DELETE method.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.title: Payment Void Response

status.description: Indicates whether the void operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the void operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the void operation.

state.description: The current state of the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the void operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: Response schema for the Payment Void operation, indicating the status and details of the void request.

AuditInformation.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user who created the void operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the void operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the void operation was performed automatically.

AuditInformation.description: Details of the audit information related to the void operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the processing time of the operation, providing insight into the efficiency of the request handling.

schema.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
